children: US ecommerce acceleration platform's Q3 revenue grew 38% yr/yr, beating analyst expectations
Company reported Q3 net income of $32 mln, reversing a loss last year
Company raised its full-year outlook after strong Q3 performance
Pattern sees Q4 revenue between $965 mln and $985 mln
Company expects Q4 adjusted EBITDA of $54 mln to $55 mln
Pattern raises full-year revenue outlook to $3.50 bln-$3.52 bln
BRAND PARTNER EXPANSION - Co said growth was driven by both existing brand partners expanding and new brands joining its platform
TECHNOLOGY & DATA - Co attributed results to its proprietary AI-driven technology and data platform optimizing ecommerce performance for brands
NON-AMAZON & INTERNATIONAL GROWTH - Co highlighted strong growth in non-Amazon and international revenue
